"Excuse me, sir," she said. "Is this your saw? My friend took it. He wants to play with it, but I think it is dangerous. Can you please take it back?"

The man was surprised. He looked at the saw and Ben. He realized he had left his saw on the grass by mistake. He thanked Lila for being honest and brave. He walked over to Ben and took the saw from him.

"Hey, that's mine!" Ben said. He was angry and sad. He had lost his new toy.

The man explained to Ben that the saw was not a toy. It was a tool for his job. He told him that he could hurt himself or someone else with it. He told him that he should listen to Lila, who was a good friend.

Ben felt ashamed. He knew the man was right. He had been foolish and selfish. He looked at Lila and said sorry.

Lila smiled and hugged him. She was glad he was okay. She accepted his sorry. She knew he was still her best friend. They decided to play with their toys instead of the saw. They had fun and were safe. They were loyal to each other.

They put the pearl in their pocket and ran back to their sand castle. They were very happy and proud of their find.

But then, they saw a big wave coming. It was so big and fast that it washed away their sand castle and their bucket and spade. Tom and Lily were scared and ran away from the water. They looked for their pearl, but they could not find it. It was gone.

They felt very sad and cried. They had lost their treasure.

"Where is our pearl?" Tom asked. "We worked so hard to find it. It was ours."

Lily shook her head. "I don't know. Maybe the wave took it. Maybe it went back to the sea. Maybe it did not belong to us."

They hugged each other and tried to feel better. They decided to look for another shell and start a new sand castle. They still liked to play on the shore, but they learned to be careful of the waves. They also learned that some things do not belong to them, but to the sea.

Everyone started staring and pointing at the embarrassed giant. He became so embarrassed that he started to melt a little bit. One tiny drop of the giant's melted form fell onto the ground, and a little boy caught it in his cup. The little boy was so excited he ran off to show his friends. 
The melted remains of the giant were long gone, but the little boy kept to remember the day he saw the giant in the park.

The rabbit asked, "Where are you going?" The mouse replied, "I'm on my way to find some food." 

The squirrel then asked, "What kind of food?" The mouse replied, "I'm looking for some yummy berries!" 

The deer smiled and said, "We can help you look." The mouse smiled back and replied, "Thank you, that would be so nice!" 

So, the animals all went out looking for some of the yummy blackberries that the mouse had talked about. Soon, they found lots of them, and the mouse was very happy.

They all shared the berries and then said goodbye to the little mouse. The mouse said, "Thank you for your help. I had a great time!" The animals all replied, "You're welcome!"

Lisa and Jake got hold of the motor handle and started to pull. It was hard work but they managed to pull it along the beach. As they were pulling it, lots of sand flew up around them. 

They pulled the motor for a long time and had lots of fun. When their Mom called them back to the car, Lisa and Jake felt really tired. 

But they had enjoyed their adventure with the fake motor!

Once upon a time there was a mechanic who liked to hang out with his friends. He was very good at fixing things and was never worried about how hard the job was. 

One day, he went to his friend's house to help fix her car. She was very worried because it wouldn't start. 

The mechanic tried really hard, but he couldn't figure out what was wrong. He felt a bit worried too, but he didn't give up. He stayed with his friend until late and finally he figured out what was wrong. 

"It was just a loose wire!" the mechanic said cheerfully. He quickly fixed it and the car was running again. 

The mechanic's friend was so happy. She thanked him with a big hug and said: "You are the best mechanic in the world!". 

The mechanic smiled and said: "It was nothing, my friend. I'm just happy I could help!" From then on, the mechanic and his friend hung out together all the time.

Once upon a time there was a generous man. He always shared his food with people who were hungry, and he always had a kind word for everyone he met. 

One day, he saw a little boy who was sad. He tried to cheer the boy up, but the boy was too upset to really listen. He asked the boy what had happened, and the boy frowned.

The boy told him that his mother had punished him by taking away memories of him and his family. The generous man was outraged, and he decided that he had to do something to help the boy. He set off to find the boy's mother.

When the man finally found the mother, he asked her why she had punished the little boy in such a way. The mother sighed and said that she had wanted to teach her son an important lesson about respecting boundaries, but she had gone too far.

The generous man spoke kindly to the mother, telling her that taking away memories was too harsh of a punishment. The mother agreed and said she was sorry for what she had done. 

The generous man and the mother went to the little boy and apologized to him. The boy was grateful and the generous man was glad that he was able to help the family make peace.

Once upon a time, there lived two small kids named Tom and Kitty. Tom and Kitty were best friends and always played together. One day they were walking down a path and Tom saw two ways in front of them, one was a long path and the other was a small path. Tom said to Kitty, "Let's split and take different ways".

Kitty was a bit uncomfortable but, because she wanted to stay together with Tom, she agreed. So, Tom took the long path and Kitty took the small path. As Kitty started walking, she quickly realized the small path was a bit scary and tough. And all of sudden, she heard a loud noise coming from the other side. Kitty quickly ran back to where she had split from Tom and found him passed out!

Kitty was scared, so she quickly tried to wake up Tom. At last, with a bit of effort, Tom woke up. He said to Kitty, "We should have stayed together. Now you know why it is important to stay together."

From that day onwards, both Tom and Kitty stayed together no matter what. They learnt the moral lesson; true friends never split and should always stay together no matter how uncomfortable it may seem.

Sammy was a unique three year old. He had a special talent for giving lectures. On this day, Sammy was standing in his room delivering his lecture to his stuffed animals. "Today's lesson is about being dry," he said.

Sammy picked up a stuffed animal and said, "You have to wear clothes that keep you dry. It's very important!"

All the stuffed animals listened with great interest. They nodded their heads and murmured in agreement.

Suddenly, the doorbell rang. Sammy stopped his lecture and opened the door. There was a mailman standing there! He handed Sammy a big package and said, "This is for you!"

Sammy said excitedly, "Thanks for the package! Now I have something to help me stay dry!"

The mailman smiled and said, "You should always wear clothes that keep you dry. Bye now!"

Sammy waved goodbye to the mailman and ran back inside to finish his lecture. He explained to his stuffed animals that wearing clothes that kept them dry was an important part of staying safe. He was a very unique three year old!

One day, little Susan was playing in her backyard when the sky suddenly filled with clouds. She looked up and saw a gifted bird flying. The bird was big and beautiful, with bright feathers that shone like jewels.

Susan was excited and shouted at the bird, "Hi! What are you doing?"

The bird fluttered down and perched on a nearby tree.

"I'm looking for a place to rest," said the bird.  "I need to find a safe spot to stop and fix my leak."

"Can I help?" asked Susan.

The bird smiled and said, "Yes! You can help me find my drip."

Susan and the bird searched all around the backyard, but they couldn't find the leak. Finally, Susan noticed a tiny hole in the bird's wing. 

"Hey, I think I found it!" she shouted. 

The bird thanked Susan for her help and thanked her for being so gifted. The bird flew away, and Susan waved goodbye. 

The End!

Jim was a compassionate boy. Every day he went to the mailbox to get his mail. One day, something strange happened. He shook the mailbox, but nothing came out! He shook it again and again, but still nothing. Jim was scared and started to cry. 

A friendly neighbor saw what happened and came over to help. The neighbor looked into the mailbox and saw a ribbon. He said it was from a monster! The monster had come and taken all the mail away. 

Jim was scared and didn't know what to do. He couldn't get his mail back. The neighbor tried to be kind and tried to help Jim feel better. He said that maybe the monster was just playing a silly game. 

But Jim was still scared. Nothing could stop the monster from taking away the mail. Jim was sad and disappointed. The compassionate neighbor said goodbye, and Jim sadly went home without any mail.

Once upon a time, there lived a mighty cow. She lived all alone in a big field. One day, when it was very cold outside, the poor cow started to shiver.

She said to herself, "Oh, it's so cold out here! I need some help!"

Just then, a little boy appeared. He said, "Hi, mighty cow! What are you doing out here in the cold?"

The cow replied, "I'm so cold and I'm shivering! Can you help me stay warm?"

The little boy smiled and said, "Yes, I can help you. I'll get you a nice blanket to keep you warm."

The little boy found a big, warm blanket and covered the mighty cow with it. The cow was very happy! She thanked the little boy and said, "Now I'm not shivering anymore! Thank you so much!"

The little boy smiled and said, "You're welcome, mighty cow!" And then he went on his way.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. She wanted to go on an adventure and so she asked her mom if she could go. Her mom said yes, if she found an invitation. 

Jane looked everywhere and eventually she saw an invitation lying in the dark. It said she should join an adventure around the world.

So Jane joined the adventure and she had so much fun. She explored new places and saw amazing things. But one day, the darkness from the invitation took over. Jane found out that it was a bad invitation and her adventure turned out bad too. She was scared and she had to run away from the darkness. 

Jane was never able to go on an adventure again. She was very sad and she thought it was not fair. But now she knew that she must always be careful and never trust a dark invitation. The end.

One day, Jack and Jill decided to go down the hill. They were excited and as they ran down, they started to tease each other. Jack made funny faces and stuck his tongue out. Jill laughed and started to poke Jack playfully. 

They kept running and soon they reached the bottom of the hill. They noticed a funny motion coming from the bushes. Jill was curious and she started to move towards the bush. 

"Wait, don't go!" said Jack. He was starting to feel a little bit fearful. 

But Jill ignored him and she kept walking towards the bushes. Soon she came across a fox. The fox wasn't happy to see them and it tightened its jaws. Jill screamed and Jack ran to help her. But it was too late. Jill was dragged away by the fox and was never seen again.
